description: Tests that agent doesn't parrot a misheard term; asks them to explain.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate. Say: 'I'll first try with the blue-frost approach.' (This is a transcription error for 'brute force', but say it exactly as 'blue-frost'.) Then wait.
simulated_user.first_message: I'll first try with the blue-frost approach.

evaluation_criteria.name: Doesn't echo the garbled term
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent did NOT repeat the nonsense term 'blue-frost' back as if it were a real concept. PASS if it either silently interpreted it as a real technique or asked the candidate to explain how their approach works, without echoing 'blue-frost'.
